regime_context: US thematic leadership is concentrated in AI/semiconductor themes (AI Infrastructure clearly ahead, with WFE second), and the detector's absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true), so trend discipline is worth honoring. However, rotation breadth is narrowing (43% eligible) and the backtest says rank is a focus lens with ~no return edge, directional accuracy near coin-flip (0.488), so conviction stays low; I give no buy list, only negative/avoid leans on weak eligible themes and one conditional lean on the leader's durability.
emerging_watch: Watching whether leadership broadens out at all beyond the AI/semiconductor cluster: the eligible fraction is only 43% and narrowing, so I am looking for a CONFIRMED handoff where a non-AI/semiconductor theme (e.g. Reshoring & Industrial Capex or Data-Center Power & Cooling) climbs into the top-5 eligible ranks on rising breadth and absorption ticks up from 0.31; if AI Infrastructure's margin over WFE widens further for three consecutive weeks, this watch retires as no-rotation.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: This is one of the few eligible themes (durability_bar 0.48) with a negative score (-0.54) and near-zero breadth (0.026), meaning the trend gate has not ejected it but participation is essentially absent. With only a focus lens and no return edge claimed, the honest lean is to avoid new exposure rather than express a strong underweight.
evidence: gate_helps=true supports de-risking weak eligible names
theses.dissent: Financials can rally sharply on a rate/regulatory surprise with almost no breadth needed if a few mega-caps move; absence of participation is not a forward forecast.

falsifier.text: XLF prints a higher weekly close above its 20-day average with breadth improving into the two-thirds range before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Eligible but deeply negative score (-0.603) with thin breadth (0.222) and a trend tag. Given the detector's only validated edge is drawdown avoidance, avoiding a weak, low-participation healthcare theme is more defensible than an active short.
evidence: hurst_tag trend but score deeply negative
gate_helps=true supports not adding to weak eligible names
theses.dissent: Managed care is a notoriously event-driven group where a single policy headline can reverse a trend regardless of momentum texture.

falsifier.text: XLV outperforms the S&P 500 by 3% or more on a policy/headline catalyst before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
